# proxmox_acme_challenge_schema (Data Source)

Lists the ACME plugin types Proxmox knows for one challenge type from `/cluster/acme/challenge-schema`, together with the credential fields each plugin expects. Use the ids as `proxmox_acme_plugin.api`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_acme_challenge_schema" "dns" {
  type = "dns"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Challenge type, usually `dns`. An empty value disables the filter.

### Read-Only

- `fields` (Map of String) Comma separated credential field names per plugin id.
- `plugins` (List of String) Plugin ids sorted alphabetically.
